$comment: T-3.35 mission thresholds, asserted by `pnpm sim-run --scenario mission` (and its three-seed CI job). Six friendly bots play greybox-01 against its committed encounter, paced by the director, at each of `budgets` (the director's human count, overridden for this tool alone), for up to `runSeconds` a seed. A scripted squad leader walks fireteam 1 up the overwatch route and fireteam 2 up the assault route stop by stop (a stop is reached once every member on its feet is within `arriveM`, or `stopSeconds` have passed), holds the objective with both, and sends the nearest bot on its feet to revive whoever goes down; the bots fight, take cover and follow the orders on their own. Asserted per budget, on a run of at least `completionMinSeeds` seeds: completion share at least `minCompletion[budget]` (the three-seed CI job reports completion and does not assert it: three runs cannot measure a rate). The completion floors sit just under the baseline measured when this landed (2026-09-23: 30% at one human, 15% at six, over 20 seeds): they catch the squad getting worse, not a target met — bots lose most firefights today (docs/BUGS.md). Over all runs: enemies under fire (suppression at or above `underFireLevel`, or hurt in the last `hurtSeconds`) spend at least `minCoverShare` of that time in a cover point they hold; and at least `minEpisodesPerEngagement` suppression episodes (a squad soldier's suppression rising through `episodeLevel`) per engagement (a stretch of enemy contact). AI cost: `bench.enemies` riflemen and `bench.bots` friendly bots with one human, `bench.seconds` of it; the AI's share of the 33.3 ms tick must stay under `maxAiShare`.
